big_case.notes: Pro se emergency application to the Circuit Justice seeking an injunction to provide witness protection and to compel the Department of Justice to take a criminal complaint, arising from a Section 1983 suit against the Attorney General dismissed for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction and affirmed below. Denied in chambers six days after submission with no response called for, no referral and no amicus. No doctrinal, institutional or public consequence beyond this litigant.
